initialExam.title: UPSC Indian Forest Service (IFS) 2026
initialExam.description: Indian Forest Service examination for forest conservation and wildlife management officers. Prelims 24 May (result out 15 Jun 2026); Mains from 22 Nov 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree with at least one Science subject or Engineering Degree
initialExam.qualifications: Bachelor's Degree with Science subject / B.E./B.Tech
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Same as CSE. Mains: Two optional science papers (Botany, Zoology, Chemistry, Physics, Geology, Forestry, Agriculture, etc.).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers (400 marks). Mains: 6 papers (1400 marks). Interview: 300 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Indian Forest Service officer managing national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, and forest divisions
initialExam.careerGrowth: ACF → DCF → CF → CCF → APCCF → PCCF → Head of Forest Force.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Apply through UPSC CSE application 2. Indicate IFS preference 3. Appear for IFS Mains separately
initialExam.perks: Government bungalow in forest areas, Vehicle, DA, HRA, Medical
